title: NINA Autofocus Run Variance
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nina:autofocus
| search run_sec=*
| stats avg(run_sec) as avg_run_sec perc90(run_sec) as p90_run_sec count as samples by profile_name
| sort 0 - avg_run_sec
description: Measures NINA autofocus run time by profile.
value: Autofocus latency grows when seeing, focuser health, or configuration quality drifts.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for NINA autofocus run time to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 NINA autofocus run time.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long NINA autofocus run time usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
